must.title: Security Requirement
must.description: Ensure no new security vulnerabilities are introduced during translation.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in SAST scan.
acceptance_criteria: SAST scan shows zero critical vulnerabilities.
Security audit confirms no new vulnerabilities.

must.title: Reliability Requirement
must.description: Ensure system reliability is maintained during and after translation.
must.metric: System uptime remains at 99.9% or higher.
acceptance_criteria: System uptime is monitored and remains at 99.9% or higher.
No critical failures occur during translation.
Post-translation monitoring shows stable system performance.

should.title: Performance Requirement
should.description: Ensure system performance is not degraded by the translation process.
should.metric: System response time remains under 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests show no degradation post-translation.
System meets defined response time metrics.
Load tests confirm system stability under expected load.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: Scalability Requirement
should.description: Ensure the system can handle increased load post-translation.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm support for 10,000 concurrent users.
System performance remains stable under increased load.

should.title: Usability Requirement
should.description: Ensure that translated components maintain usability standards.
should.metric: User satisfaction score remains at 85% or higher.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback is collected and analyzed.
Usability tests confirm no degradation in user experience.
User satisfaction surveys show scores of 85% or higher.
should.verification: User satisfaction survey and usability testing.
